info.name: Athar (أثر) API — salamiyah-hackathon
info.description:
Every endpoint of the NestJS API (generated from its Swagger document; see docs/postman/README.md).

1. Set {{baseUrl}} (default http://localhost:4000).
2. Run Auth → Login or Auth → Demo logins → Login as <ROLE>; the test script saves {{token}}.
3. Protected requests inherit Bearer {{token}} from the collection. Public requests use No Auth.

All data is fictional (demo seed). No secrets or real phone numbers are stored here.

The app UI and the Swagger title still show the earlier working name «مجلس فند» (Majlis Fund API); rename in progress.

variable.description: API origin (README §4). On a phone/LAN demo: http://<LAN-IP>:4000
Set automatically by any Login request (Bearer JWT, 8h). Never commit a real token.
Shared password of the FICTIONAL demo seed accounts (README §8). Development only.
